articles.title: Supreme Court Term to Tackle Climate, Gun and Emergency Cases
articles.summary: The Supreme Court's new term includes a climate lawsuit against oil companies and a challenge to an Illinois assault weapons ban, plus fast rulings on its emergency docket.

articles.title: G7 to Release 100 Million Barrels of Oil and Diesel to Ease Prices
articles.summary: The G7 agreed to release 100 million barrels of oil and diesel through the IEA after President Trump threatened a U.S. diesel export ban.

articles.title: Student Protests Over Education Standards Disrupt 700+ French Schools
articles.summary: Protests over education standards have spread across France and disrupted more than 700 schools, while ministers describe damage to school facilities and a growing disturbance.
